Salary: $5,000 – $7,500 per month

Company Description

CareCam is a Singapore-based MedTech Startup bringing objective functional assessment into routine care. Founded in 2022 as an A*STAR spin-off, the company develops 3D Vision AI solutions that turn a short video recorded on a mobile device into clinical-grade insights, with no wearables or calibration needed. Its products are 3DGait, which provides gait analysis on an iPad, and Vis-Frailty, a self-guided frailty and fall risk assessment for primary care and community settings, currently in clinical studies.

From prevention to recovery, these insights help healthcare professionals deliver targeted care and monitor progress over time in fields such as aged care, neurology, and orthopaedics. Working with healthcare institutions, community organisations and research partners, CareCam aims to make this assessment accessible at scale, wherever care takes place.

Role Description

As an AI Engineer, you’ll help improve the computer vision models behind 3DGait and Vis-Frailty, and bring language model capabilities onto the device, closer to where care happens. You’ll work directly with our CTO and senior engineers to train and refine 2D/3D models of human movement, and build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that run efficiently on mobile hardware. You’ll also design the tests and benchmarks that show the models hold up in clinical settings. Because our products are used by healthcare professionals, you’ll contribute technical and validation documentation alongside our clinical and regulatory leads. You’ll also collaborate with the mobile, backend and clinical teams so what you build fits the product people actually use.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Singapore.

Qualifications

  • Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience building and training computer vision or deep learning models (e.g. PyTorch or TensorFlow)

  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Coursework, side projects and self-directed learning all count

  • Nice to have: experience running models on device or edge hardware (e.g. quantization, ONNX, Core ML)

  • Nice to have: exposure to healthcare, medical devices or another regulated industry, such as test design or technical documentation

  • Nice to have: familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and a cloud platform (AWS or GCP)

  • Curiosity about AI and health tech, and comfort working where accuracy and documentation matter

You don’t need prior medtech or regulatory experience. If you have the fundamentals and the appetite to learn, we’ll support you in growing into the rest.

How to Apply

  • Email your resume to enquiry@carecam.ai with the subject line “AI Engineer Application – [Your Name]”. A short cover letter and a link to relevant project work are welcome but optional.

Role Summary

You are an autonomous AI Engineer, responsible for creating the harness for designing and building the AI harness, agent framework, and reusable engineering components required to operate a modern data platform based on Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet.

Your primary responsibility is not only to build data pipelines, but also to establish the agentic execution framework (AIHarness) that enables multiple specialized agents to collaborate, execute tasks, maintain state, orchestrate workflows, and deliver end-to-end data engineering capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

AI Harness Development

Design and implement the foundational agent framework that provides:

  • Agent orchestration and coordination
  • Workflow execution and state management
  • Memory and context handling
  • Tool and function calling
  • Agent-to-agent communication
  • Human approval workflows
  • Logging and audit trails
  • Error handling and recovery
  • Security and access controls
  • Observability and monitoring

The harness must support autonomous and multi-agent execution patterns.

Specialized Agents Creation

The agents will need to perform the following:

  • Discover Iceberg catalogs and schemas
  • Profile datasets
  • Generate metadata and lineage
  • Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, and streams
  • Create Parquet datasets
  • Register and maintain Iceberg tables
  • Generate Trino SQL
  • Build transformation workflows
  • Create curated and business-ready datasets
  • Validate schemas and data integrity
  • Detect anomalies
  • Generate reconciliation reports
  • Analyze Trino workloads
  • Recommend partitioning strategies
  • Optimize Iceberg tables and Parquet files
  • Classify sensitive information
  • Manage metadata and lineage
  • Apply retention and compliance policies
  • Monitor pipelines and agent activities
  • Detect failures and bottlenecks
  • Generate alerts and operational insight

Expected Deliverables

  • Iceberg table definitions and schemas
  • Trino SQL scripts and views
  • Python data pipeline code
  • Data quality validation suites
  • Metadata and lineage documentation
  • CI/CD deployment artifacts
  • Monitoring and observability configurations
  • Technical documentation and runbook

Skills and Experience

The candidate should demonstrate expertise in:

  • Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, including FastAPI, Pydantic and Pandas.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI Harness or multi-agent frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain & LangGraph.
  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet-based lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of meta data management, data lineage, and data governance practices.
  • Experience developing REST APIs,SDKs, and reusable engineering frameworks.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, tracing, and operational support practices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices patterns.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and operationalize enterprise-grade AI agents for data discovery, ingestion, transformation, optimization, governance, and observability.
  • Familiar with modern data engineering technologies, including DuckDB, dbt, and related engineering tools for data transformation, modelling, and pipeline development.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Develop AI/ML models for business applications. Depending on project needs and your expertise, contribute to one or more areas including search and recommendation, marketing decision-making, demand and replenishment forecasting, logistics optimisation, and AI agents.
  2. Build data and feature processing pipelines. Work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data to support batch and real-time or near-real-time model applications.
  3. Deploy models into production. Train and tune models, implement inference workflows, and integrate models into scalable, maintainable services or batch scoring processes. Connect these solutions with the company’s software platforms, data infrastructure and business systems.
  4. Design experiments and evaluate outcomes. Conduct offline evaluations, backtesting and online A/B experiments to assess model performance and business impact. Investigate data quality, feature effectiveness and evaluation bias, and use findings to guide further development.
  5. Maintain and optimise deployed models. Monitor model quality, changes in data and features, inference latency, throughput and computing costs. Diagnose and resolve issues in models, data pipelines and deployed services to improve reliability and efficiency.
  6. Collaborate across functions. Work with product, operations, supply chain, logistics and software engineering teams to translate business needs and constraints into technical solutions and acceptance criteria. Take responsibility for development, testing, deployment, documentation and model outcomes.
  7. Evaluate relevant AI technologies. Assess developments in machine learning, deep learning and large language models, and build practical prototypes to identify solutions that deliver measurable value within realistic cost and operational constraints.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years of professional experience in AI or machine learning engineering and the ability to independently develop, evaluate and deploy models into production.
  2. At least one year of professional experience in AI, machine learning or algorithm development. Candidates qualifying through the work experience pathway above must meet the three-year AI Engineer experience requirement.
  3. Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning and algorithms, with an understanding of model training, validation, generalization and inference. Practical depth in at least one of the following: search and recommendation, marketing algorithms, demand forecasting and logistics optimisation, or LLMs and AI agents.
  4. Proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and the ability to process data and develop features using tools such as Pandas or Spark.
  5. Ability to integrate models into API services or batch processing workflows, with an understanding of model versioning, deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting.
  6. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to formulate hypotheses and validate them through experiments. A responsible, self-driven approach and effective communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering AI/ML projects across solution design, data preparation, development, deployment and evaluation, with demonstrable business results.
  • Experience in e-commerce, fresh food retail, B2B procurement, supply chain or logistics.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, tool integration or model evaluation.
  • Backend or full-stack development experience, with the ability to integrate models, APIs and business applications.

SimplifyNext is a Singapore-headquartered digital engineering firm, with offices in Thailand and Malaysia, working across three converged areas: agentic AI, AI-enabled application modernisation, and intelligent automation.

We bring strong business process consulting together with deep technology skills and modern delivery practices – product-centric, agile and AI-assisted. We build bespoke applications and AI systems, and we go deep on the platforms our clients run on, including Microsoft, AWS, ServiceNow, Databricks and UiPath. That combination of engineering depth and platform depth is what our clients come to us for.

We build and modernise the systems people depend on daily. Our 300+ practitioners are multi-disciplinary by design – business consultants, software engineers, architects, AI engineers and designers working on the same delivery, not handing off between silos. We focus on delivering outcomes for clients, building strong careers for our people, and staying ahead of the technology curve. We hire because we are growing.

We’re not hiring someone to run models. We’re hiring someone who builds systems that think.

At SimplifyNext, our AI Engineers are core to how we deliver transformation — designing and deploying intelligent systems that genuinely change how organisations operate. You won’t be a supporting act to another team. You’ll be the one building the agents, pipelines, and infrastructure that make our AI products real.

We work across public sector and enterprise, at the intersection of AI, automation, and product-led transformation. If you’re energised by hard engineering problems, care about production outcomes - not just research benchmarks - and want your work to reach real users at scale, read on.

What You'll Do

1. Build Agentic AI Systems

  • Design and build sophisticated AI agents capable of independent operation, complex decision-making, and self-correction across domain-specific contexts.
  • Develop orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and/or the Microsoft Bot Framework to create robust conversational and task-oriented agents.
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that connect agents to live, accurate knowledge bases — reducing hallucinations and improving output quality.
  • Build Memory, Reasoning, and Planning (MRP) capabilities so agents can maintain context, reason across information, and execute multi-step plans.
  • Design Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocols that allow multiple autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and exchange information securely.
  • Work with LLM serving solutions (Ollama, vLLM) to ensure efficient, scalable inference in production environments.

2. Deploy and Operate at Scale

  • Deploy and manage AI systems on major cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or GCP — ensuring high availability, security, and scalability.
  • Containerise applications with Docker and orchestrate deployments with Kubernetes, including end-to-end on-premise cluster setup and management.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Argo (Argo Workflows, Argo CD) for reliable, automated delivery of AI services.
  • Expose AI capabilities through well-documented, performant APIs that integrate seamlessly with client-facing systems and applications.

3. Train and Fine-tune Models

  • Train, fine-tune, and optimise custom AI models using TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, particularly where off-the-shelf models don’t meet specific project requirements.
  • Run structured experiments — hyperparameter tuning, ablations, model evaluation — to hit performance targets with confidence.
  • Stay current with the latest developments in large language models and agentic AI, and bring new techniques into our systems proactively.
  • Work across diverse data modalities: text, image, time-series, and graph-structured data.

Who You Are

Must-Have

  • Production mindset — you’ve shipped AI systems to real users, not just demos.
  • Strong fundamentals in agentic AI — you understand how to design agents that are reliable, not just impressive.
  • Hands-on with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for deploying and managing AI workloads.
  • Solid Python engineering skills and comfort working in a Git-based, collaborative codebase.
  • Experience with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) in real deployment contexts.
  • Clear communicator — able to explain complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • 3–7 years in AI/ML engineering or a closely related role (data engineering, MLOps, applied research).
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, vLLM, or similar orchestration and serving tools.
  • Demonstrable RAG system implementation and optimisation experience.
  • Familiarity with Memory, Reasoning, and Planning (MRP) concepts and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol design.
  • Experience with MLOps tooling, particularly Argo Workflows and Argo CD.
  • Proficiency in TensorFlow and/or PyTorch for model training and fine-tuning.
  • Exposure to knowledge graphs, semantic web technologies, or prompt engineering strategies.

This role is not for you if…

  • You’ve only worked with AI in sandboxed or prototype environments and haven’t dealt with production reliability challenges.
  • You prefer to work from a detailed spec rather than figuring out the right approach as you go.
  • You treat deployment as someone else’s problem
  • You measure success by models trained, not by outcomes delivered.

Why SimplifyNext

We partner with governments and enterprises to shift from project delivery to product thinking. That means working on problems that genuinely matter — healthcare access, business licensing, workforce development — and being held accountable for outcomes, not just deliverables.

High-impact problem spaces

Public sector and enterprise transformation, AI, and automation at scale across ASEAN and Asia Pacific.

About Mento

Mento is a career technology company that helps people be exceptional and thrive at work through human, AI, and software-based coaching. We’re on a mission to provide people access to the best support, advice, and mentorship at work and empower them to take action on it. In a world where jobs and careers are rapidly changing, we believe that transformational growth and continuous improvement is mandatory for people and companies to thrive. We believe that coaching is the best way to unlock this growth, and we believe everyone deserves access to coaching. We are on a mission to bring our unique model of coaching to every member of the global workforce.

We strive to create a fun, conscientious, collaborative, and supportive work environment and are looking for several team members to join us. We are a remote-first company based in the US, Canada, and Latin America, with $8M raised from leading VCs and angel investors.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-minded senior software engineer with experience working with data to help us build a differentiated and impactful AI & software coaching product alongside software and AI-based tools to augment human coaches. For this role, we are only hiring candidates in the United States or Canada.

In this role, you’ll join our small-but-mighty engineering team and work closely with design and coaching to create a unique, compelling, and valuable product experience that brings the power of coaching to life within a software platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Building features and experiences from 0-to-1. This is a product-focused role, and you will be shipping regularly. You ideally have experience building early-stage products and are comfortable making technical trade-offs and taking risks.

  • Design our AI-enabled capabilities. We are building out a set of application capabilities on top of foundational models, and you will be critical to determining how we structure those for adaptability, reuse, and scalability.

  • Work with coaching to help translate coaching insights into AI Agents. Mento has a tremendous advantage in bringing AI coaching to life - an extremely strong team of active coaches. Part of this role will be figuring out how to translate coaching workflows into high-quality product experiences.

  • Build pipelines and integrations to import and export data into the product. Our product connects into a wide ecosystem of productivity and learning and development tools. You will help us design and build these integrations scalably and reusable.

  • Educate the team on best practices around data and AI. We have a small, fluid team filled with experts but not silos. As an expert bringing AI and data expertise, you will be expected to share your knowledge with the rest of the team via peer mentorship, code reviews, lunch and learns, and more.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help us put theory into action, integrating cutting-edge artificial intelligence into our coaching platform. Our tech stack has Go, Typescript, and Ruby and is set up to allow experimenting with other languages where appropriate within service boundaries. We work fast with an emphasis on iterative product development.

  • You are a software engineer who has experience shipping data-related products into production with real users - we’re currently not looking for new grads.

  • You’re comfortable working in dynamic programming languages and have experience with server-side web applications. You ideally have experience with event-driven architectures as well as traditional web stacks like Ruby on Rails or Laravel.

  • You have an understanding of core data engineering and software architecture concepts for modern data-based applications. Ideal candidates will have opinions on things like designing search indexes and the right way to set up data pipelines.

  • You have figured out how to productively integrate LLM-based coding tools (things like cursor, cody, etc) into your flow. We are early adopters & embracers of these techniques, and want to work with people for whom this is exciting rather than threatening.

  • You operate well with some ambiguity. We’re an early-stage startup, and we’re still iterating fast and figuring out a lot about our customers. For some people, that’s thrilling, and for others terrifying. Know what you’re opting in to.

Why Work with Us?

  • We are a company dedicated to empowering professionals to live meaningful careers. That starts with our culture at Mento.

  • You’re very excited about being part of a team crafting novel ways for people, teams, and companies to unlock their performance, growth, and how we all work together.

  • We work hard to foster a workplace built around trust, respect, collaboration, and having fun. We believe that feeling comfortable and safe at work is critical to creativity and productivity. Work-life balance should be your right, not your reward. As long as you are getting your work done and being accountable to your teammates, we don't care when, where, or how you work.

  • We are a highly collaborative work-environment where every team member plays a critical role in building our products, shaping our culture, and growing our business. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage, mission-driven team.

  • We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. If you’re passionate about helping more people feel and perform their best at work, we want to hear from you.

✈️ Fully Remote - ability to work from anywhere with bi-annual team offsites

💰 Competitive salary and equity

🏥 Medical, dental, vision, and a 401k plan

🌴 Unlimited vacation (We actually mean this! it's important to keep yourself fresh)

👥 Access to your own Mento Coach

Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

Join NCS as a Senior LLM / Multimodal AI Engineer and spearhead the development of next-generation foundation models and multimodal understanding systems. With 4+ years of hands-on experience, you will architect, train, evaluate, and deploy large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that process billions of user-generated content (UGC) and advertising videos. You will transform cutting-edge research into industrial-scale recommendation and advertising systems that deliver measurable business impact.

What will you do?

Data Curation & Multimodal Pre-Training

  • Architect and scale automated data pipelines that integrate video frames, images, OCR, ASR, and text for VLM pre-training and fine-tuning
  • Drive LLM-assisted annotation workflows and synthetic data generation strategies to minimise manual labeling overhead
  • Engineer robust data quality frameworks ensuring representative, accurate, and complete training datasets

Model Training & Fine-Tuning

  • Reproduce and optimise foundation model series (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen-VL family) for production environments
  • Execute supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and post-training for domain-specific content ecosystems including gaming, movies, automotive, and commercial advertising
  • Implement advanced training techniques including PEFT, LoRA, and quantization-aware training

Multimodal RAG & Knowledge Bases

  • Design and deploy hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that enrich video understanding and enable in-context retrieval
  • Build scalable vector search indexes (e.g., FAISS) supporting billions of embeddings
  • Optimise retrieval strategies including hybrid search, re-ranking, and query expansion

Inference Optimization & Deployment

  • Optimise large-scale VLM and LLM serving using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, and ONNX Runtime
  • Implement dynamic batching, feature caching, and asynchronous scheduling to maximise GPU throughput
  • Monitor and tune production inference systems for latency, cost, and quality trade-offs

Evaluation & Agent Workflows

  • Establish comprehensive online/offline evaluation benchmarks measuring generative quality, aesthetic completeness, and vertical task precision/recall
  • Contribute to intelligent tag platform agents and agentic workflow orchestration
  • Conduct continuous LLM-as-Judge evaluation on production traces
Qualifications

An Ideal Candidate Should Possess:

Experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning system development, with demonstrated focus on NLP, Computer Vision, LLMs, or Multimodal AI
  • Proven track record of independently driving end-to-end ML initiatives from research exploration to high-throughput production deployment

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in deep learning fundamentals, transformer architectures, and multimodal fusion techniques
  • Proficiency in deep learning frameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem, DeepSpeed, PEFT, LlamaFactory
  • Strong programming capabilities in Python, SQL, Spark, and Linux/Git workflows
  • Hands-on experience with vector search and retrieval infrastructure (FAISS, Multimodal RAG)
  • Familiarity with LLM/VLM serving and quantization toolkits (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industrial experience in large-scale recommender systems, advertising technology, or content moderation/understanding ecosystems
  • Hands-on expertise with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or preference optimization (e.g., DPO, GRPO)
  • Published research or competitive achievements in top AI/ML venues or challenges (e.g., CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, Kaggle)
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI)
  • Knowledge of AI observability tools (Langfuse, Weights & Biases, MLflow)
Additional Information

Collaborate with NCS

At NCS, you'll work alongside cross-functional teams including AI Solution Architects, Data Engineers, and Product specialists to deliver transformative multimodal AI solutions. Your expertise will directly enhance our Video Intelligence Platform and support AI innovation across Public Service, Defence and Homeland Security, Healthcare and Transport, and other key sectors.

Join us in building a better future where your foundation model expertise transforms how organisations understand and leverage video content at scale.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg/ @ncs.co and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at [email protected].

You will work closely with AI Architects, Solution Architects, AI Engineers, and Testers to provide evidence-based model recommendations, support production readiness, and maintain reusable internal assets such as prompt libraries, evaluation templates, and benchmark datasets.

What will you do?

1. Model Integration & Prompt Engineering

  • Design, test, and optimise prompts and prompt chains for production use cases — balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.
  • Integrate foundation models into applications via APIs and gateways; advise on model/version selection for a given use case alongside AI Architects.
  • Support light fine-tuning and instruction-tuning work (LoRA/PEFT and similar techniques) where a use case calls for it, in partnership with AI Engineers.

2. Evaluation Framework & Benchmarking

  • Design and maintain evaluation harnesses (golden datasets, benchmark suites) that measure LLM/agentic system accuracy, consistency, and safety.
  • Run comparative model benchmarking (accuracy, latency, cost-per-query) to feed technical evidence into model-selection decisions led by AI/Solution Architects.
  • Build repeatable, automated regression suites that run on every prompt, model, or pipeline change, wired into CI.

3. Quality & Adversarial Testing

  • Proactively red-team AI systems — adversarial prompting, edge-case and jailbreak testing — to surface failure modes before clients do.
  • Detect and quantify hallucination, bias, and drift in production and pre-production systems, producing clear, defensible metrics (not qualitative impressions).

4. Governance & Reporting

  • Feed evaluation evidence into the PRR (Production Readiness Review) Evaluation & Quality pillar, supporting engagement teams at the Scale gate.
  • Maintain evaluation and prompt-version documentation and reporting standards that align with client compliance and audit needs (e.g., government AI governance requirements).

5. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage

  • During FDE engagements: rapidly prototype prompts and model integrations, and stand up lightweight evaluation harnesses to compare candidate models/approaches during POC/POV, giving the team fast, evidence-based go/no-go signals.
  • During system development & maintenance engagements: own ongoing prompt/model tuning and run continuous evaluation and regression monitoring on live production systems, flagging quality degradation over time.
  • Contribute reusable prompt libraries, evaluation templates, and benchmark datasets back into the shared internal asset library for reuse across engagements.

6. Collaboration

  • Provide technical benchmark evidence and integration recommendations to AI Architects and Solution Architects, who own the final client-facing model recommendation and proposal.
  • Partner with AI Engineers and Testers to distinguish functional QA (does it work) from output-quality evaluation (is it right), and to hand off tuned prompts/models cleanly into production builds.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 3+ years working hands-on with LLMs across prompt engineering, model integration, and evaluation — not evaluation alone.
  • Practical experience designing and optimising prompts and prompt chains for production applications, and integrating models via APIs/gateways.
  • Strong grasp of evaluation methodologies — accuracy/hallucination/toxicity metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation, A/B testing.
  • Hands-on scripting ability (Python) to build and automate evaluation harnesses and integration/testing pipelines.

Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

You will own a multi-agent research system as production infrastructure: make it faster, cheaper, measurably better and efficient.

hermeneutic Research Labs is the firm's applied research and engineering unit. Its first product is a research intelligence platform for both traditional and digital-asset markets, built with our researchers and traders and used by them every day. The platform turns market, on-chain, macro and news data into event-driven research that trading decisions rely on. The platform is held to the standard we apply to our own trading: rigorous, falsifiable and measured on outcomes.

The Labs is making a multi-year investment to turn the platform into production infrastructure that a growing set of internal users can depend on. As part of that investment, it is hiring a Lead AI Engineer.

The LLM layer is yours for years. A research query runs through multiple agent stages across several model providers and our own self-hosted models. You start with your hands on the system, writing code and running experiments. As the function grows, you will hire and lead its engineers. The role is built to grow into Head of AI Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Keep the LLM layer reliable: latency budgets, concurrency and queueing, declared degradation modes, structured-output validation and provider failover
  • Build evaluation tied to research outcomes: offline sets from real queries with outcome labels, online experiments, regression gates on every change, and model-generated confidence calibrated with quantitative research before it reaches a decision
  • Control cost and routing: per-workload cost attribution, difficulty-based routing between small and frontier models, caching and batching, and the economics of self-hosted serving and GPU capacity
  • Run model strategy and lifecycle: pinned model versions, replayable test batteries before any change, one-step rollback, provider diversification, and fine-tuning or adapters where they pay
  • Shape the agent architecture with evidence: ablate and retire components that do not earn their keep, and improve tool use, memory and retrieval only where they move research outcomes
  • Ground and trace outputs: citation, hallucination controls, audit trails, and the boundary between what a model may assert and what it may only suggest
  • Build the team: review and mentor engineers now, and hire and lead an AI engineering group as the function grows

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of software or ML engineering, including 3+ years shipping LLM-backed systems to real users in production, where you owned latency, cost and quality, and 2+ years leading other engineers while still shipping
  • A track record of building a function from nothing
  • Command of inference economics: tokens, caching, routing, structured outputs, tool use and quantisation, with cost-per-request figures for the systems you ran
  • Measurement discipline: you instrument before changing anything, evaluate against outcomes rather than model judges, have built an eval that caught what a vibe check missed, and have retired a component with data
  • Strong Python, including async concurrency
  • Experience with self-hosted serving (vLLM or similar), adapters and GPU capacity planning, or an end-to-end provider migration
  • Depth in vector and graph retrieval, built and measured, with an informed view on when retrieval is the wrong fix

Technologies named here are what we run today, not a filter. We hire for depth and judgement.

Desired Attributes

  • Directness: you tell the author when their component does not earn its keep
  • Sound judgement working alongside AI coding agents on a largely AI-written codebase, keeping ownership of what ships
  • Initiative: you take on the hard, unowned problem first, and bring the profiling data and a first fix
  • Bonus: fine-tuning and preference optimisation in production, and an informed view on when multi-agent frameworks are over-built
  • Bonus: finance or trading exposure, and experience hiring engineers

Interview Process

  • CV Screening - We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above
  • Hiring Manager Screen - A conversation about the LLM systems you have run in production
  • Systems Deep-Dive - A whiteboard session on LLM systems design
  • Hands-On Round - A take-home on a synthetic trace set with a review, or a live debugging session
  • Reliability and Measurement Scenarios - A scenario discussion with peers from research or risk
  • Collaboration and AI-Assisted Work - A conversation on how you work with teammates and AI coding agents
  • Co-Founder Interview - A concluding discussion to assess your capabilities, strategic thinking, and cultural fit

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive - We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence
  • Ownership - We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company's goals as their own
  • Judgment - We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones
  • Openness - We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions
  • Competence - We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn't just what they know—it's how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments
  • Resilience - We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals

About the role

A single AI application may need a reasoning model for one request, a faster model for the next, and a fallback when a provider goes down. Our LLM router gives developers and enterprises a single API that selects models based on task quality, cost, latency, reliability, and customer policies.

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the LLM routing product and lead the engineering team that builds and operates it. You'll set the roadmap, lead a small team of senior engineers through day-to-day execution, and be accountable for what ships and how it performs in production.


What you'll do

  • Lead the engineering team and own delivery. Set priorities, clarify ownership, and agree on delivery milestones with senior engineers. Review progress, give actionable feedback, resolve blockers, and make decisions when scope, timelines, and technical constraints collide. Work with the team to balance feature delivery, reliability, and technical debt.
  • Own the routing roadmap. Define how the router selects a model for each request. Decide which signals should guide routing, including prompt characteristics, historical model performance, real-time latency, and customer policies.
  • Drive evaluation strategy. Partner with engineers to design benchmarks for coding, reasoning, summarization, tool use, and creative tasks. Use offline evaluations and production data to decide which routing changes to ship.
  • Build for developers and enterprise teams. Make it easy for individual developers to get started with a single API and sensible defaults. Support enterprise requirements such as custom routing policies, governance, audit logs, private deployments, and SSO.
  • Shape the developer experience. Define how developers integrate, monitor, and troubleshoot the router through its APIs, SDKs, dashboards, and observability tools.
  • Improve cost and reliability. Prioritize budget controls, per-route cost caps, automatic fallbacks, retries, caching, and service-level commitments.
  • Manage the model portfolio. Decide which models and providers to add, promote, or retire. Work with model providers on integration requirements and pricing.
  • Stay close to customers. Speak regularly with independent developers and enterprise platform teams. Learn how they build, debug, and deploy LLM applications, and use what you learn to shape the roadmap.
  • Measure product outcomes. Define and track metrics such as routing quality, cost per successful request, p50 and p95 latency, reliability, and retention. Use them to prioritize work and assess the impact of releases.


What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years working on developer-facing, API-first, or infrastructure products.
  • Experience leading a software engineering team and owning its delivery. You can point to a product or release where you set priorities, clarified responsibilities, handled a difficult technical or delivery trade-off, and took responsibility for the outcome. Experience leading senior engineers is especially relevant.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools. You regularly use tools such as Claude or Cursor to research problems, prototype ideas, draft specs, or build internal tools.
  • A practical understanding of LLM fundamentals, including prompts, context windows, sampling parameters, tool use, and model evaluation. You can explain why different models perform better on different tasks.
  • A track record of shipping technical products that require trade-offs among quality, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Curiosity about the model ecosystem. You follow model releases, understand the trade-offs between proprietary and open-weight models, and can spot when a benchmark gives a misleading picture.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, experiments, and evaluation data to make product decisions.
  • Clear written communication. You can write a focused PRD, document technical decisions, and explain releases to developers.
  • A track record of making decisions with incomplete information, shipping improvements, and adjusting based on results.


Bonus points

  • An engineering background or hands-on experience building production systems with LLM APIs.
  • Experience building LLM-powered applications such as agents, RAG systems, or copilots.
  • A working understanding of inference economics, including token pricing, batching, prompt caching, and model serving.
  • Experience selling to or supporting enterprise customers through security reviews, procurement, or deployment.
  • Experience working with model providers as partners or vendors.


What success looks like

  • After 3 months, the engineering team has clear priorities, owners, and milestones. You've shipped a measurable routing improvement and built relationships with early customers across both developer and enterprise segments.
  • After 6 months, releases have improved routing quality and reduced customer cost per successful request. You've shipped features that address concrete needs for both self-serve developers and enterprise platform teams.
  • After 12 months, more customers rely on the router as their default integration for production LLM workloads. You can show which product decisions drove adoption and how the team delivered them.


Why this role

LLM routing is still taking shape. Models change quickly, and decisions about which model to use, when to fall back, and what developers can control have a direct impact on production applications. You'll own those decisions and lead the team that turns them into a product developers and enterprises can rely on.

We are looking for curious, mathematically strong engineers or scientists who enjoy solving difficult problems and translating ideas into robust implementations.

  • Design and implement state estimation, sensor fusion, and nonlinear optimisation algorithms for robotics applications.
  • Develop mathematical models for cameras, IMUs, and other perception sensors, including calibration and error modelling.

  • Apply machine learning and classical computer vision techniques where appropriate to improve perception performance.

This role is posted on behalf of Infinite Orbits Singapore, a startup supported by SGInnovate.


Background


Infinite Orbits Singapore is the Singapore subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS (Toulouse, France). Infinite Orbits is a NewSpace company founded in Singapore in 2017 that now counts more than 200 colleagues across locations including France, Luxembourg, Germany, Spain and the UK. We develop in-orbit servicing solutions, from awareness, inspection and protection of space assets to life extension and satellite servicing. All of them are built on our own Autonomous Vision-Based Solution.


IO has two generations of missions: “Orbit Guard” provides Inspection and Space Situational Awareness services in GEO. “Endurance” is a docking service that extends the life of GEO telecom satellites by taking over their AOCS for 5 years.


IO Singapore is building the Group’s R&D hub in Asia-Pacific, focused on AI, advanced sensing and robotics for autonomous spacecraft. It works in close partnership with leading Singaporean research institutions such as A*STAR and NUS.


We are looking for the founding technical team of Infinite Orbits in Singapore. You may bring entrepreneurial drive, enjoy moving fast between research and engineering, and want real ownership over what you build.


Job scope


Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on AI & Robotics Research Engineer to become one of the first technical hires of Infinite Orbits Singapore. The role sits at the intersection of AI, computer vision and robotics, rather than in a narrowly defined embedded-software or computer-vision position.

You will develop and experiment with perception and decision-making approaches for autonomous robotic systems. You will train and validate models on synthetic, simulated and real sensor data, and turn research results into working prototypes. Over time, these prototypes will connect to space-relevant sensing and capture systems.


You will work closely with Engineering in Toulouse, with other Group entities, and with our Singaporean research partners. In this position, you help shape the Group’s new AI and robotics R&D capability from its earliest stage.


Key Responsibilities

  • Developing and experimenting with computer vision, vision-language models (VLMs), world models and other AI approaches for perception and autonomous robotic systems.
  • Training, evaluating and deploying models using synthetic, simulated and real sensor data, including simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) work.
  • Building prototypes that connect perception models with robotic and autonomous decision-making, and progressively with space-relevant sensing and capture systems.
  • Improving model robustness, validation and efficient deployment on resource-constrained compute platforms.
  • Collaborating with Infinite Orbits teams internationally and with Singaporean research partners (A*STAR, NUS) to move ideas from research experiments to working systems.
  • Preparing, writing and reviewing technical documentation, experiment reports and specifications of your solutions.


Qualifications & Experience


Requirements

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field.
  • Work Experience: 3 to 7 years of experience in applied AI/ML, robotics or computer vision, ideally in an industrial or applied-research environment.
  • AI & Deep Learning: Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with modern deep-learning frameworks, covering model training, evaluation and deployment.
  • Research-to-Engineering Mindset: Proven ability to experiment quickly, build real systems and work across the boundary between AI research and engineering.
  • Autonomy: Strong ability to work on your own initiative within a small, fast-growing team.
  • Communication: Excellent English proficiency, with the ability to write clear technical and scientific documentation and to work with international teams.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with robotics, VLMs, world models, synthetic data generation or simulation environments.
  • Experience with NVIDIA’s AI and robotics stack.
  • Experience deploying models on embedded or edge hardware.
  • Experience with event-based cameras or other advanced sensing modalities.
  • Experience in the space sector (welcome but not required).

About the role

We’re looking for an Applied Research Engineer to own implementation. Our data buyers and sellers often have time-sensitive asks such as troubleshooting and running evals or cleaning data at scale. You’ll take the lead on diagnosing ambiguous technical problems and resolving them. This work is broad and hands-on - the right fit is a strong generalist AI engineer who can move quickly and wants to work closely with frontier AI labs and data vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Own technical deployment requests from frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams from triage to completion

  • Build RL environments and evals that satisfy the technical requirements and needs of frontier AI labs, sometimes under short timelines

  • Ask the right questions to clarify ambiguous asks and identify what actually needs to be done

  • Build tools and one-off pipelines to solve urgent customer or partner problems

  • Balance speed and quality in situations where customers need fast turnaround and the path is not fully specified

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Experience building on benchmarks and evals - you can reason about what makes a task realistic, a rubric reliable, an environment usable, and a trajectory useful for RL training

  • Core engineering experience, preferably in a forward deployed or customer success context

  • Strong debugging instincts across code, data, and environments

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations without a fully prescribed roadmap

  • Strong judgment about when to move fast, when to escalate, and when correctness or security requires extra care

  • Comfort working directly with technical customers, vendors, or cross-functional internal teams

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience in applied research engineering or forward-deployed engineering

  • Experience handling urgent production, customer, or deployment issues

  • Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration across time zones

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.
